"""Main: finite native-provider integer health and read-only actual device telemetry."""
import argparse
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

B=Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
T=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.tools/intel-llvm-v711/install')
I=Path('/opt/intel/oneapi/compiler/2026.1')
O=B/'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('provider_health_owner',O)
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m)
PCI='0000:05:00.0';DUMP=Path('/sys/bus/pci/devices')/PCI/'devcoredump'
FAULT=re.compile(r'page fault|fault response|timestamp stuck|wedg|engine reset|gt reset|guc.*(?:timeout|timed out|failed)|device.*lost|Timed out wait for G2H|Check job timeout|Timedout job|Schedule disable failed|trying reset|\breset (?:queued|started|done)\b',re.I)
EXPECTED=['STATUS '+PCI+' 0','QUEUE '+PCI,'H2D 65536 complete','KERNEL 16384 complete','D2H 65536 complete','PASS '+PCI+': 1 round, 16384 exact words']
UTILITY=dict(PATH='/usr/bin:/bin',HOME='/home/yayoi',LANG='C.UTF-8',LC_ALL='C.UTF-8')

def environment(engine,phase):
 import sys
 sys.path.insert(0,str(B/'main-current-xe-b9-controller-source-v2'))
 from policy import environment as selected_environment
 return selected_environment(engine,phase=='startup')

def main():
 p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--engine',choices=['xe'],required=True);p.add_argument('--phase',choices=['startup','model'],required=True);p.add_argument('--serial',type=int,required=True);p.add_argument('--startup-review',type=Path)
 a=p.parse_args();assert 1<=a.serial<=20
 with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
  fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
  ref=B/('xe-source-llvm-small-health-root-v3/record.json' if a.engine=='xe' else 'latest-update-main-official-health-build-root-v2/record.json')
  proof=json.loads(ref.read_text());assert proof['passed'] and proof['complete'] and not proof['active']
  binary=proof['binary'];assert m.sha(binary['path'])==binary['sha256']
  env=environment(a.engine,a.phase);assert Path(env['UR_ADAPTERS_FORCE_LOAD']).is_file()
  out=B/('main-current-xe-b9-provider-health-'+a.engine+'-'+a.phase+'-root-v'+str(a.serial));assert not out.exists();out.mkdir()
  r=dict(active=True,complete=False,passed=False,commands=[],boot_id=Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(),
   engine=a.engine,phase=a.phase,main_reviewed=True,controller_sha256=m.sha(__file__),binary=binary,environment=env,
   binary_build_receipt_sha256=m.sha(ref),reset_executed=False,retry_count=0,model_executed=False,gpu_executed=False,
   pci_bdf=PCI,raw_log_budget_bytes=64<<20,total_wall_seconds=180)
  def save(): (out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
  owner=m.Owner(out/'commands',save);r['commands']=owner.commands
  def run(label,args,chosen=UTILITY):
   c,so,se=owner.run(label,args,chosen,out,wall=30,cpu=60,file_cap=64<<20,text_cap=64<<20,total_cap=96<<20,rss_cap=4<<30)
   r.setdefault('evidence',{})[label]=dict(stdout=so.read_text(),stderr=se.read_text());save()
   m.require(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code']==0,label)
   return so.read_text(),se.read_text()
  if a.phase=='model':
   assert a.startup_review and a.startup_review.is_relative_to(B)
   review=json.loads(a.startup_review.read_text());assert review['passed'] and review['main_reviewed']
   r['startup_review']={'path':str(a.startup_review),'sha256':m.sha(a.startup_review)}
  cursor=None
  def kernel(label,args):
   text,_=run(label,['/usr/bin/journalctl','-k','--no-pager','-o','json',*args])
   rows=[json.loads(x) for x in text.splitlines()];assert len(rows)<=65536
   selected=[x for x in rows if PCI in x.get('MESSAGE','') or re.search(r'\bxe\b',x.get('MESSAGE',''))]
   faults=[x for x in selected if FAULT.search(x.get('MESSAGE',''))]
   r[label]=dict(relevant_entries=selected,fault_entries=faults,dump_present=DUMP.exists(),filter=FAULT.pattern);save()
   assert not faults and not DUMP.exists()
  try:
   kernel('kernel-before',['-b'])
   text,_=run('kernel-cursor',['/usr/bin/journalctl','-k','-n','0','--show-cursor','--no-pager'])
   hit=re.search(r'^-- cursor: (.+)$',text,re.M);assert hit;cursor=hit[1];r['kernel_cursor_before']=cursor
   text,_=run('device-list',['/usr/bin/xpu-smi','discovery','-j']);listing=json.loads(text)
   rows=listing['device_list'];assert len(rows)==1 and rows[0]['device_id']==0
   r['level_zero_gpu_count']=len(rows);r['selected_device_index']=0
   text,_=run('device-selected',['/usr/bin/xpu-smi','discovery','-d','0','-j']);device=json.loads(text)
   assert device['device_id']==0 and device['pci_bdf_address']==PCI and device['device_state']=='normal'
   r['device_discovery']=device;r['device_state']=device['device_state']
   text,_=run('device-usage',['/usr/bin/xpu-smi','stats','-d','0','-j']);stats=json.loads(text)
   assert stats['device_index']==0 and stats['pci_bdf']==PCI and set(stats['memory']['used_mib'])=={'tile_0'}
   used=stats['memory']['used_mib']['tile_0']['current'];assert type(used) in [int,float] and 0<=used<=256
   r['device_used_mib']=used;r['device_usage']=stats
   r['gpu_executed']=True;save()
   text,error=run('integer-health',[binary['path'],PCI],env)
   lines=text.splitlines();assert lines[:6]==EXPECTED and all(x.startswith('LIBRARY ') for x in lines[6:])
   names=sorted({x.removeprefix('LIBRARY ') for x in lines[6:]})
   assert any('libsycl.so' in Path(x).name for x in names) and env['UR_ADAPTERS_FORCE_LOAD'] in names
   r['health_protocol']=lines[:6];r['mapped_libraries']={x:dict(path=x,sha256=m.sha(x)) for x in names}
   assert not re.search(r'UR_RESULT_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST|ZE_RESULT_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST|terminate called|\[FATAL\]',error,re.I)
   kernel('kernel-after',['--after-cursor',cursor]);r['kernel_gate_passed']=True;r['complete']=True
  except BaseException as error:r['error']=repr(error)
  finally:
   if cursor and owner.active is None:
    try:kernel('kernel-final',['--after-cursor',cursor])
    except BaseException as error:r['kernel_gate_error']=repr(error)
   r.update(active=owner.active is not None,boot_unchanged=r['boot_id']==Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(),finished_utc=m.utc())
   r['passed']=bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and r['boot_unchanged'] and not r.get('error') and not r.get('kernel_gate_error'));save()
  print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ['passed','error','engine','phase','device_used_mib','mapped_libraries']}))
  return 0 if r['passed'] else 1
if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())
